normal_operations.source: const otherTab = await page.context().newPage(); await otherTab.goto(url); await expect(otherTab.locator('.app-shell')).toBeVisible();
await page.locator('.editor-footer').getByRole('button', { name: '保存を再試行', exact: true }).click();
const saved = await backup(page), savedImage = await nativeImage(page);
const recovery = await fullNewClone(browser, url, saved.bytes, saved.project);
await migratedPage.getByRole('button', { name: '読み込みを再試行', exact: true }).click();

boundary_fixture_operations.source: await page.evaluate(async () => { const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration(); if (!registration) throw new Error('No cached registration'); await registration.update(); });
if (armed && this.name === 'projects') { armed = false; throw new DOMException('E12 native quota fixture', 'QuotaExceededError'); }
const migratedPage = await migrationContext.newPage(); await seedVersionOne(migratedPage, url, saved.project, savedImage.tables.outbox);
if (armed && this.name === name && args[0] === 'importDrafts') { armed = false; throw new DOMException('E12 copied native migration quota fixture', 'QuotaExceededError'); }

physical_flight_mode.condition: 原whenの実端末機内モード
physical_flight_mode.source_support: lines179-181 use Playwright context.setOffline and navigator.onLine; no physical-device radio procedure.
physical_flight_mode.required_next_observation: Cache the fixed candidate on the original required device, leave genuine unsent UI edits, enter actual flight mode, then record cold editing/export/resume and retained input.

real_storage_exhaustion.condition: 実ブラウザー/端末容量の枯渇
real_storage_exhaustion.source_support: lines184-190 inject one native projects.put QuotaExceededError; a real quota is not exhausted.
real_storage_exhaustion.required_next_observation: Observe genuine quota refusal and normal recovery in the required environment; keep fault injection as supplemental evidence only.

actual_old_application_upgrade.condition: 異なる実旧アプリbytesからの途中更新と安全地点適用
actual_old_application_upgrade.source_support: lines139-156 change only the service-worker CACHE identity; application bytes stay the same fixed candidate. lines207-215 leave worker scope through a fixture route.
actual_old_application_upgrade.required_next_observation: Bind actual old/new application bytes and their build/source hashes, create cached unsent work with the old app, then perform actual update and safe-point resumption without replacing the original conditions.

actual_old_database_migration.condition: 実旧アプリが作成したDBの移行失敗と再開
actual_old_database_migration.source_support: seedVersionOne lines99-131 writes a copied native version10 layout and pending rows directly; lines224-242 fault and retry this copied DB.
actual_old_database_migration.required_next_observation: Retain the actual old-app DB/input bytes and pending operations, observe failure atomicity and ordinary retry on that original state, and keep copied-layout injection as supplemental.

first_uncached_product_guidance.condition: 原negativeの初回未取得を成功と扱わず説明する
first_uncached_product_guidance.source_support: lines216-221 only assert that fresh offline context goto rejects. Product failure guidance, save status and durable invariants are not asserted in this control.
first_uncached_product_guidance.required_next_observation: Record actual first acquisition refusal and the product/browser guidance applicable to an uncached app; do not infer the whole negative clause from rejected navigation alone.

unfetched_material_control.condition: 原negativeの未取得素材を利用済みと扱わない
unfetched_material_control.source_support: The 2237-byte fixture has project+manifest only, no attachment entities or asset entries; this spec never opens an unfetched material through its product control.
unfetched_material_control.required_next_observation: Prepare the original cached/unsent work with an actual unfetched material, open its normal product control while offline, assert the missing indication and no false successful-use/save status, and retain original author data.

os_file_save_location_cancel.condition: 原negativeの保存先取消を成功と扱わない
os_file_save_location_cancel.source_support: backup helper accepts a Playwright download and reads bytes; no OS save-location dialog or cancellation operation/assert exists in this spec.
os_file_save_location_cancel.required_next_observation: Cancel the actual OS Files destination from the normal export action; directly observe cancellation feedback, no false completed export, input/pending preservation and subsequent ordinary retry.

restore_pending_identity_and_materials.condition: 専用出力復元後の送信待ち同一性・素材継続の直接確認
restore_pending_identity_and_materials.source_support: fullNewClone lines90-91 records pendingCount without asserting equality; it asserts project/new-clone ID/history/replay behavior but no material/world byte equality. The fixed fixture has no asset entries.
restore_pending_identity_and_materials.required_next_observation: If adjudicating pending/material preservation, compare the restored pending operations and actual relevant material/world bytes in the same original-given run; counts and constant observation flags alone do not establish those properties.

fixture_hash_binding_at_execution.condition: 実行入力を予定fixture SHAへ照合
fixture_hash_binding_at_execution.source_support: lines135-136 read/inspect the fixture but do not compare against a predeclared fixture SHA; attachGiven records actual bytes/hash at runtime.
fixture_hash_binding_at_execution.required_next_observation: Before adjudication, compare the attached actual 2237 bytes and SHA with the planned fixed fixture, and bind build/worker/source hashes from the same execution.
